# Discord Music Bot

Personal Discord music bot. Slash commands, yt-dlp resolution (YouTube, YouTube Music, Spotify, SoundCloud, keyword search), per-guild queue, and a LAN-accessible admin web panel.

## Features

- `/play <query>` — accepts YouTube, YouTube Music, Spotify, SoundCloud URLs, or a keyword search (uses first result)
- `/skip` — skip the current song
- `/queue` — show the current queue with Skip/Stop buttons
- `/stop` — clear the queue, stop playback, leave voice channel
- `/remove <selector>` — remove a single position (`3`) or a range (`1-7`, inclusive)

All commands are restricted to the channel set by `BOT_COMMANDS_CHANNEL_ID` and only respond there.

## Admin Panel

Reachable on `http://<server-ip>:8787` from your LAN. HTTP Basic auth (`ADMIN_USER` / `ADMIN_PASSWORD`).

Features: live log tail, restart bot, stop bot, `git pull` and restart.

## Setup

```bash
cp env.example .env
$EDITOR .env   # fill in DISCORD_TOKEN, IDs, ADMIN_PASSWORD
npm install
npm run deploy   # register slash commands with your guild
npm start
```

## Files

- `src/index.js` — bot entrypoint
- `src/deploy-commands.js` — registers slash commands with your guild
- `src/commands/*.js` — slash command handlers
- `src/music/` — queue, player, URL resolver
- `src/web/server.js` — admin web panel
- `systemd/*.service` — user-mode systemd units
